justification: The assessment correctly reports INVALID using the reference witness K_{2,4}. This connected six-vertex graph has even degrees (4,4,2,2,2,2). Deleting any vertex leaves connected K_{1,4} or K_{2,3}, so it is 2-connected. Every bipartite cycle uses equally many vertices from each part, precluding a Hamiltonian cycle with part sizes 2 and 4.
